rawResponse:
### 1. Clarify flow fallback scope
**File:** `src/presets/base/templates/en/AGENTS.senti.md`
**Issue:** The fallback line `If skills are unavailable, run senti flow --request "<request>" instead.` now sits after both the explicit-flow rule and the standalone docs-sync rule, making it ambiguous whether docs-sync should also fall back to `senti flow`.
**Suggestion:** Scope the fallback explicitly: `If the user explicitly starts the flow and skills are unavailable, run senti flow --request "<request>" instead.`

### 2. Use exact skill naming consistently
**File:** `src/presets/base/templates/en/AGENTS.senti.md`
**Issue:** The new text says `dedicated flow-sync skill`, while the removed text used the exact skill name `/senti.flow-sync`. This weakens naming consistency in an instruction template.
**Suggestion:** Change the line to: `**MUST: Standalone docs-sync runs use the dedicated /senti.flow-sync skill.**`
